protocol.purpose: Strictly inductive 18,495-gene pan-cancer, non-lung, and within-cohort audit
protocol.qc: training observed RNA only; finite fraction >= 0.95, median >= 1, MAD > 0
protocol.pool: top 1000 training-fold MAD genes; residualized analysis ranks training cohort-Z MAD after raw QC
protocol.residualization: per-cohort training-observed mean and SD + 1e-5 applied to train and validation before screening and fusion
protocol.owa: off-diagonal ascending implicators, weights 2*(L+1-r)/(L*(L+1)); inherited null-calibrated forward search
protocol.cohort_splits: all/residualized: exact archived tcga_fold_ids; nonlung: five-fold stratified cohort and event, shuffle seed 42
protocol.classification_training: matched 4-modality UnifiedDeepFuzzyModel, 28 epochs, lr 0.0018, embed 40, seed 200+fold, maturity weights
protocol.rna_only: observed-validation AUROC of in-fold logistic regression C=0.25 on the same RNA representation
protocol.cox: same backbone and selected tensors; logit of fused probability as continuous log-risk clamped [-15,15]; unweighted full-training-risk-set Breslow loss, plus 0.35 times mean observed-modality Cox loss and 0.04 times mean rough boundary; OS-event gate initialization, no composite-outcome weights
protocol.cox_auroc: secondary composite-event classification AUROC of sigmoid(log-risk), monotone in Cox risk
protocol.c_index: benchmark _compute_c_index; greater risk for earlier OS death; tied times excluded and tied risks receive half credit
protocol.bootstrap: 1000 class-stratified paired resamples; BH separately within each comparator-reference family
protocol.reactome: union of five fold candidate pools; all human pathways with K_bg >= 2 form BH family, k >= 2 shown
protocol.lung_markers: SFTPA2, SFTPD and NKX2-1 are reported as observed; marker exclusion is not forced
